'''James Busby''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Shreveport tournament]] on 16 September 2000 with Pile (Hidden Forest or something), according to David Monteiro's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1235">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-17-shreveport-louisiana-9-16-00d1235/ shreveport-louisiana-9-16-00], DeckTech (David "JWRP119" Monteiro, 17 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-17-shreveport-louisiana-9-16-00d1235/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
